WorkBuddy official credits, OpenDesign workspace queries, Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan via console cookie, local credits metering for the SCNet Token Plan and Volcano Ark Coding Plan via AK/SK signature), plan/API dual-track billing with per-1% & full-window Token Plan usage estimates, custom provider balance lookup (configurable HTTP endpoint) and balance progress bar, plus peak/off-peak pricing display with pre-switch popup & system-notification alerts (position / lead time / type configurable), in a bilingual (Chinese/English) UI.

description.en: DeepSeek Harness officially recommended context insight and management plugin provides a context browser, context trends, a multi-agent collaboration view, key context event insights, cross-session statistics, and tool call and command activity, giving you a complete picture of context composition, token usage, and evolution.
description.de: Offiziell von DeepSeek Harness empfohlenes Plugin für Kontext-Einblicke und -Verwaltung: Kontext-Browser, Kontexttrends, Ansicht der Multi-Agenten-Zusammenarbeit, Analysen wichtiger Kontextereignisse, sitzungsübergreifende Statistiken sowie Aktivitäten von Tool-Aufrufen und Befehlen, für einen vollständigen Überblick über Kontextaufbau, Token-Nutzung und die Entwicklung des Kontexts.
description.es: Plugin de análisis y gestión del contexto recomendado oficialmente por DeepSeek Harness: ofrece un explorador de contexto, tendencias del contexto, una vista de colaboración multiagente, análisis de eventos clave del contexto, estadísticas entre sesiones y actividad de llamadas a herramientas y comandos, para comprender por completo la composición del contexto, el uso de tokens y su evolución.
description.fr: Plugin d’analyse et de gestion du contexte officiellement recommandé par DeepSeek Harness : il propose un explorateur de contexte, des tendances du contexte, une vue de collaboration multi-agents, une analyse des événements clés du contexte, des statistiques entre sessions et le suivi des appels d’outils et des commandes, pour comprendre pleinement la composition du contexte, l’utilisation des tokens et l’évolution du contexte.
description.ja: DeepSeek Harness公式推奨のコンテキスト把握・管理プラグイン：コンテキストブラウザー、コンテキストの推移、マルチエージェント連携ビュー、重要なコンテキストイベントの詳細分析、セッション横断統計、ツール呼び出しとコマンドの動向を提供し、コンテキストの構成、トークン使用量、変遷を包括的に把握できます。
description.pt: Plugin de insights e gerenciamento de contexto oficialmente recomendado pelo DeepSeek Harness: oferece navegador de contexto, tendências de contexto, visualização da colaboração multiagente, análise de eventos importantes do contexto, estatísticas entre sessões e atividade de chamadas de ferramentas e comandos, para compreender completamente a composição do contexto, o uso de tokens e a evolução do contexto.
description.ru: Официально рекомендуемый DeepSeek Harness плагин для анализа и управления контекстом: обозреватель контекста, тенденции контекста, представление взаимодействия агентов, анализ ключевых событий контекста, статистика по всем сессиям, а также динамика вызовов инструментов и команд — полное понимание состава контекста, использования токенов и его развития.

plugins.name: dsh-usd-3d-preview
plugins.title: dsh-usd-3d-preview
plugins.description: In-browser OpenUSD 3D preview for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: registers a document preview for .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz, composes the stage with a WebAssembly OpenUSD engine (composition arcs included), renders it with three.js in a studio-lit viewport, and makes authored UsdPhysics joints and colliders interactive. Three read-back modes explain the stage — complete LIVRPS composition arcs per prim, a layer-stack composition panel, and a USDA text mode (authored text, or a labelled reconstruction of a binary crate) — plus a prim-path inspector and a prim details panel. Previews a human+agent modeling-session archive by its `session.json`: the newest `snapshots/<rev>.usda` renders through that same viewport, with a panel stating the session id, model revision and the newest commit record's object summary. Optional read-only S3-compatible asset-library support: `s3://` and http(s) stages open by address (referenced layers included), a sidebar object-storage browser, and a local-checkout updater (terminal command and a Settings/Plugins update panel). No converter process, no upload, no native toolchain
